newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco stocks resume upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Morocco stocks resume upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange resumed its upward trend on Wednesday, boosted mainly by the banking sector, including Wafabank, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 436.08 points, up 0.04 percent on the previous session.
"Generally speaking, the continuing rise of Wafabank shares was behind the bourse index surge," an analyst at Upline Securities said.
Wafabank jumped 15 dirhams to close at 545 dirhams compared with the previous session.
The bank has a market capitalisation of 2.7 billion dirhams and registered a liquidity rate of 8.2 percent in the first half of the year, one of the highest rates on the market, an analyst said.
Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie, gained two dirhams to close at 320 dirhams.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, which has the market's largest capitalisation, remained stable at 694 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 31.3 million dirhams, up from 25.4 million dirhams.
